rubric.role_summary: Onsite CNC programmer for precision manufacturing of building-system components, developing and optimizing multi-axis machining programs and supporting production-floor validation and troubleshooting.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Onsite CNC programmer for precision manufacturing of building-system components, developing and optimizing multi-axis machining programs and supporting production-floor validation and troubleshooting.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of hands-on experience as a CNC Programmer in a precision machining environment.
- Strong proficiency with at least one major CAM software package; Mastercam, Fusion 360, SolidCAM, Siemens NX, or equivalent are acceptable.
- Strong understanding of G-code and M-code programming, including manually editing and troubleshooting programs at the control.
- Experience programming multi-axis CNC equipment, including 3- and 4-axis mills and CNC lathes.
- Ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, GD&T (ASME Y14.5), and 3D CAD models.
- Strong working knowledge of machining principles, cutting-tool technology, speeds and feeds, workholding methods, and fixturing.
- Familiarity with metrology tools and basic inspection techniques, including calipers, micrometers, and height gauges.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Technical degree or certificate in CNC Programming, Manufacturing Technology, or a related field.
- Mastercam experience.
- 5-axis simultaneous machining and multi-tasking/mill-turn experience.
- CMM experience.
- Knowledge of advanced CAM features, including high-speed machining strategies, rest machining, adaptive clearing, and toolpath optimization.
- Experience with post-processor customization or CNC control systems such as Fanuc, Haas, Siemens, Mazak, Okuma, or equivalent.
- Background in aerospace, medical, automotive, or other precision industries with tight-tolerance requirements.
- Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
- Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement experience.
- High school diploma or equivalent.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Austin, TX area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
